newsitem.title: USA: 3M stops sponge shipping after EPA complaint.
newsitem.headline: 3M stops sponge shipping after EPA complaint.

text.p: Minnesota Mining & Manufacturing Co said Thursday it has stopped all shipments of its kitchen sponge line after the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency Region 5 office ordered the company to immediately stop selling the product.

An EPA spokesman office said in a statement the O-Cel-O Sponge, O-Cel-O Sponge Scrubber KITCHEN and O-Cel-O Sponge Scrubber COOKWARE must be registered with the EPA because their labels claim they prevent, destroy or repel pests.

A spokeswoman for 3M told Reuters the company had already met with the Washington office of the EPA and outlined how the product contained a pesticide that killed potentially harmful bacteria like salmonella and E. coli inside the sponge. The product did not claim to kill germs on any surfaces, she said.
The spokeswoman added that the pesticide, sodium pyrithione, is commonly used in other personal care products like shampoos and skin cleansers.
The company is negotiating with the EPA to resolve the matter and resume shipments of the products, she said.
